// Isolated cold filesystem cache: detach/remount our own APFS disk image.
// Host backing-image pages remain cached; this is not a cold physical SSD test.
// Usage: node cold.mjs <scratch-root>; cold-cache.sparseimage and copied repos must exist.
import * as fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import * as path from 'node:path';
import * as os from 'node:os';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
const require = createRequire(import.meta.url), cp = require('node:child_process');
const root = await fs.realpath(process.argv[2]);
const mount = path.join(root, 'cold-mount'), image = path.join(root, 'cold-cache.sparseimage');
process.env.HOME = path.join(root, 'cold-home');
await fs.mkdir(process.env.HOME, { recursive: true });
const exec = cp.execFile, run = promisify(exec), commands = [];
cp.execFile = (...args) => {
  const start = performance.now(), cb = args.pop();
  return exec(...args, (error, ...result) => {
    if(args[0] === 'git' && args[1][0] === 'add') commands.push(performance.now() - start);
    cb(error, ...result);
  });
};
cp.execFile[promisify.custom] = (...args) => new Promise((resolve,reject) => cp.execFile(...args,(error,stdout,stderr)=>error?reject(error):resolve({stdout,stderr})));
const rows = [];
try {
  for(const repo of ['agentsview','acme-web']) {
    const cwd = path.join(mount,repo);
    for(const variant of ['baseline','candidate']) {
      const core=path.join(root,variant,'core');
      const checkpoint=require(path.join(core,'checkpoint.js')), execution=require(path.join(core,'execution.js'));
      const integration=require(path.join(core,'claude/execution.js')).integration;
      const prepared=await execution.prepareExecution(integration,path.join(root,variant,'execution.js'),true);
      const request={cwd,owner:'cold-measurement',runtime:prepared.runtime.runtime,actor:'writer',call:'prime',edge:'before'};
      await checkpoint.captureExecution(request,prepared.runtime.contextFile);
      await checkpoint.captureExecution({...request,edge:'after'},prepared.runtime.contextFile);
      for(let i=0;i<3;i++) {
        await run('hdiutil',['detach','-quiet',mount]);
        await run('hdiutil',['attach','-quiet','-nobrowse','-noautofsck','-mountpoint',mount,image]);
        const load=os.loadavg(), start=performance.now(), at=commands.length;
        const before=await checkpoint.captureExecution({...request,call:String(i)},prepared.runtime.contextFile);
        const staged=commands[at];
        const after=await checkpoint.captureExecution({...request,call:String(i),edge:'after'},prepared.runtime.contextFile);
        if(!before?.snapshot || before.snapshot.tree!==after?.snapshot?.tree) throw new Error('cold tree mismatch');
        const row={repo,variant,iteration:i,addBeforeMs:staged,addAfterMs:commands[at+1],pairMs:performance.now()-start,load,endLoad:os.loadavg()};
        rows.push(row);console.log(JSON.stringify(row));
        await fs.writeFile(path.join(root,'cold-results.json'),JSON.stringify({method:'APFS sparse image detach/remount; host backing pages unpurged',rows},null,2));
      }
      await checkpoint.endExecutionRuntime(prepared.runtime.runtime,prepared.runtime.contextFile);
    }
  }
} finally { await run('hdiutil',['detach','-quiet',mount]).catch(() => undefined); }
